name: Stable Diffusion XL 1.0

licence.name: CreativeML Open RAIL++-M
licence.note: The card names the licence. The commercial-use flag reflects the licence's general terms (commercial use with use-based restrictions) and was not re-checked for this profile.

resolution.note: Trained on several aspect ratios, but the bucket list is unconfirmed, so no presets are listed. Multiples of 64 are often called safest; also unconfirmed.

sampling.steps.note: The Diffusers example's 40 steps, which hands over to the refiner at 0.8; this profile is for the base model alone.

warnings.message: At CFG 1 or below there is no unconditional pass, so the negative prompt has no effect.

notes: No CFG or sampler default: neither source recommends one, so the route's own default applies.
sd.cpp's SDXL example uses the sdxl_vae-fp16-fix VAE; that is a route setting, not a profile one.
